scope: Read-only next-slice feasibility observation; no source, provider, resource or workflow mutation

provider_source.strategy: one literal rewrite per distinct public_uri

facts: Alibaba Cloud CDN documents a maximum of 50 origin-path rewrite rules per domain.
Rules execute in list order; break stops subsequent rewriting.
PCRE captures can be referenced in the target path.
Origin rewrites do not change CDN cache keys.
back_to_origin_url_rewrite uses source_url, target_url, flag and sequence.
sequence ranges from 1 to 99; lower values take priority.

inference: A complete 178-route native composite cannot pass the current one-rule-per-URI compiler with its 50-rule limit. This is a code/count inference, not a live API test or a rerun of the planner.
implication: M1 remains a native-fixture milestone. Before promising complete SDK/CDN integration, derive and test an equivalent bounded routing representation from actual materialized routes. Do not truncate routes or raise the documented domain limit.
unverified: actual Alibaba PCRE and URI/query normalization
